[[File:Stardb3.jpg|thumb|250px|Death Star being designed via the Imperial Schematic Design System.]]
'''Imperial Schematic Design System''' was the name for a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] program that created virtual designs for [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] engineering projects such as the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="DSD">''[[Death Star Designer]]''</ref>

One of the blueprints, depicting an earlier version of the Death Star with its superlaser placed on the equator, had been retrieved by Rebel Alliance agents on Galvoni III in the aftermath of the Battle of Yavin.<ref name="DSOTM">''[[Death Star Owner's Technical Manual]]''</ref>
